generator_drift: For R_kappa(U)=U_4N-(1+kappa)U_2N+kappa*U_N and one common differentiable kappa(t), R_kappa(v)=kappa_prime*(U_2N-U_N). kappa=.5 is q2 (half its legacy residual); kappa=1 is Jordan. The gain-free two-lineage determinant must vanish. No unstable division by U_2N-U_N and no free exponent fit.
interpretation: Report the unperturbed residual alongside the tangent. A failing baseline cannot be rescued or certified by a compatible tangent or determinant. Nominal joint summaries and the nested drift diagnostic share samples and are not independent evidence votes.
uncertainty: The four cyclic N share the same permutation counter domain and omit the same batch jointly. N260 and N340 have distinct seeds and form two further groups. Sum group-specific delete-one covariance contributions; save every vector and the full covariance.
resources: Local CPU only; no GPU, server, new random counters, or test suites. This finite archived subset measures a new source response and does not inherit full-production precision.
